create_bias_module: create a Haiku Bias module that adds a learned bias to input tensors with broadcasting support
create_scalar_bias: create a scalar bias using hk.Bias with bias_dims set to an empty list
create_bias_with_multiplier: create a Bias module and apply it with a multiplier to add or subtract the same learned bias
create_bias_specific_dims: create a Bias module targeting specific dimensions using bias_dims to control which axes the bias applies over
calculate_bias_shape: calculate the bias shape from an input shape and bias_dims using the calculate_bias_shape utility function
